changes.title: Hat setup tidy
items: The start card's controls no longer mention the broom stand: they say the Workshop fits her broom's parts, and that spell hats are found in the forest

changes.title: Dark indoors
items: Inside the treehouse's rooms the forest behind is dark: only the house and the Ent's crowns show, which leaves more of the machine free while the island loads
Stepping out onto the Terrace the forest opens out from the doorway in a moment, and closes again as you go back in; through the telescope it fades in

changes.title: Wake first
items: A new game starts with the witch waking up in her bedroom on the home island, not on the sea chart
What's new and Options are on the pause page (Esc)
